did: I redesigned Studio's Renders on the phone after you made a preview by accident and never saw it there. Renders now names each video in plain words, a preview of a template by its name, a call by its days, and every row opens its own page. Make a preview asks first what home will make and then says over the page that home took it, with the way to Renders. On your word I added the conveyor: each render moves along pizza-named stations, in line, waiting for an oven, in the oven with the scene it is recording, boxing, ready for pickup, with set on the counter for a pause and burnt for one that couldn't be made, drawn by one strip the takes conveyor can reuse.

calls.title: Make a preview asks before home makes one
options: a question first, then a note with the way to Renders
no question, only the note after the press
calls.why: The preview was made by accident, and a new one takes the place of the one home keeps, so one more tap seemed worth it.
calls.undo: Have the button ask home straight away and drop the question's words (C134).

calls.title: Every row on Renders opens its page, waiting ones too
options: the whole row a tile that opens its page
a plain line with a separate open link
calls.why: An episode's page exists before it is made, and one tap to it was what you asked for.
calls.undo: Draw each row without its link on the Renders page (C135).

calls.title: An older home's preview row names its template from the preview's name
options: read the template off the start of the preview's name
name it generically with no link until home names the template
calls.why: Previews already on home before the update should still say which template they are of.
calls.undo: Treat a preview row without a template as unnamed (C136).

left: The conveyor's scene totals and the putting-together station show only once home runs a render image built after #2901 and its digest is bumped on the server; until then the oven shows the scene without a total.
